findings: The current source correctly converts the Asian box, London entry, rollover, and force-close clocks to UTC; requires all 24 closed M15 box bars; uses the exact box-midpoint stop and 2x-box-range target; configures the card's 2.5%/5.0%/0.5% kill switch; and performs management and exits before entry-only filters. Those headline remediation claims were independently confirmed.

StrategyDailyEntryHalt compares current ACCOUNT_EQUITY with g_qm_ks_day_start_equity. Floating P&L is therefore counted in what the code labels the approved 2.0% daily realized-loss halt, collapsing a realized-loss control into an equity-drawdown test.

Strategy_ExitSignal is true only from the configured 16:00 UTC close through 23:54. If a quote gap or close failure leaves exposure open, the mandatory London-close exit deasserts at 23:55 and stays false through midnight instead of remaining asserted until closure.

The exact card rules define midpoint SL, 2x-box-range TP, and the 16:00 time exit, but no numeric break-even rule. Strategy_ManageOpenPosition invents a 1R trigger, a 20-pip fallback, and a plus/minus one-pip stop, materially changing the approved payoff distribution without an OWNER-authorized formula.

OnInit declares no QM_FrameworkDeclareExecutionContract for the M15 host cadence, and the EA adds unused Trade/Trade.mqh outside the QM_Common include chain. Explicit QM_IsNewBar arguments do not make initialization fail closed on a wrong host chart.

The reviewed MQ5 hashes to 4513f1f1a192c5c040015a90f5fecfdac35d9d214b615e5552968f5d26870fc5 and was modified 2026-08-23; the EX5 hashes to d90ab915cd2642632fc122a381cf3aabc85d77a4118a7ce70f7880a3e62b6e70 and was last modified 2026-08-17. The producer JSON asserts compile/build-check success for those hashes, but farmctl reports NOT_ENQUEUED and no smoke report or measured saturation-backed deferred-smoke reason exists. The artifact does not prove that the old EX5 was compiled from the remediated source, so build_result fails and smoke_sanity remains UNKNOWN.

Guardrail and SPEC validation pass; all three governed set headers contain build_hash and use RISK_FIXED=1000 and RISK_PERCENT=0; active magic rows are unique, formula-correct, and resolver-backed; and no direct OrderSend or unwrapped trading method is present. These checks do not cure the realized-loss, mandatory-exit, invented-management, execution-contract, and build-evidence failures.
